name: @arena/auth-service
description: The auth service for Arena (Work Order B004; issue #69; docs/LLM-ARCHITECT-HANDOFF.md B004 acceptance block): composes the @arena/auth session protocol with the B002 persistence ports — AuthService (authenticate via an injected credential-verifier port, issueSession/validateSession/rotateSession/revokeSession/revokeAll over the sealed-token cookie contract, tenant-scope fail-closed on every validation) plus ControlPlaneSessionStore (durable sessions as versioned control-plane records; revocation-epoch cache + rotation leases in the bounded/rebuildable coordination store) and createLocalAuthStack (FT2.0 local parity: the full session lifecycle with zero providers). Authorization stays OUT: the service returns identity + the B003 workspace context; it never interprets the opaque permission policy.
